models.title: 2021 Redbull RB16B
models.author: Dave Love SketchFab
models.sourceReview:
The Redbull RB16B is a Formula One racing car designed and constructed by Redbull to compete in the 2021 Formula One World Championship. The car was driven by Max Verstappen and Sergio Pérez. The RB16B was an evolution of its predecessor, the RB16, which competed during the 2020 season. 

It is historically significant as the car that propelled Max Verstappen to his first World Drivers' Championship, ending Mercedes' seven-year streak of drivers' titles in the turbo-hybrid era. It also marked the final season of Honda's official factory involvement as an engine supplier in Formula One, securing their first drivers' title since Ayrton Senna in 1991.

![](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSu1fWs-BXRd5JvBKslBSG72ZhVGldEPwEuiNDD6P5TFtsZimqfAQF6L6I&s=10) Official full-resolution glTF export chosen because its opaque tires and carbon materials match the listing presentation. The original upload marks solid surfaces transparent. Geometry comparison is against the selected official web export, which contains 240779 triangles; the original upload contains 240827. No site simplification or texture resizing is applied.

 it’s becoming increasingly obvious that you’ve struck some kind of unholy bargain with the automotive gods themselves. Or perhaps—just perhaps—you’re secretly one of their offspring, born with an uncanny ability to summon the finest, most jaw-droppingly amazing models into your possession. Honestly, it’s enough to make anyone’s envy hit top gear.

But, true to form, I couldn’t resist sneaking in like a thief in the night, laying claim to your prized creation, and scuttling away with it in my grubby, gleeful hands. And oh, the joy—like winning a free round at the Nürburgring! So, thank you for this act of generosity—or is it a cleverly disguised flex? Either way, I shall forever remember your legendary alias: JustGame!

And every time I glance at this masterpiece,  "JustGame!"—like a rallying cry for petrolheads everywhere.

upstream.sourceDescription: BMW M1is a mid-engined sports car produced by BMW from 1978 to 1981. It was designed as a homologation special to compete in Group 4 and Group 5 racing. The M1 Turbo was a turbocharged version of the M1, designed to compete with Porsche's 935 in the Group 5 racing category.
